en.title: China Online Arrival Card: Official Free Form and Backup
en.headline: China Online Arrival Card: Fill the Official Free Form and Keep a Port Backup
en.description: Use China’s official free arrival-card service, prepare the right records, identify exemptions and recover from form errors, outages or fake paid websites.
en.heroAlt: Beijing Capital International Airport Terminal 1 arrival hall, photographed in November 2016 as a general arrival setting.

zh.title: 外国人来华网上入境卡：官方免费入口、填写与失败兜底

zh.description: 使用国家移民管理局免费的网上入境卡服务，准备填写资料，核对免填情形，并处理填错、打不开或误入收费假网站等问题。
zh.heroAlt: 2016年11月拍摄的北京首都国际机场1号航站楼到达大厅，仅作为一般抵达场景。
